comment: T3.52: hold-TAB should show only the hovered ability's description. The driver can't physically move the mouse, so we verify the _detect_hovered_ability_slot() logic by directly calling _show_ability_hints(true) (which internally detects hover) AND by reading the _last_hovered_ability_slot state. Since the driver can't control mouse position, this test focuses on confirming: (1) the panel shows when TAB is on, (2) the panel content is correct when no slot is hovered (should be empty/hidden), (3) the ability stats panel is shown alongside.
